description: This file provides utility functions for distributed process synchronization and state management in PyTorch, including context managers for timeouts, barrier synchronization, and rank detection in a distributed store environment.

methods.name: store_timeout
methods.description: Context manager to temporarily set and restore the store's timeout.

methods.name: get_all
methods.description: Retrieves all data associated with a prefix from the store, waiting for all processes to finish.

methods.name: synchronize
methods.description: Synchronizes data across all agents in the distributed environment using the store.

methods.name: _try_detecting_missing_ranks
methods.description: Detects missing ranks in the distributed process group by checking trace keys.

methods.name: _barrier_nonblocking
methods.description: Performs non-blocking barrier operations and returns the key to wait on.

methods.name: barrier
methods.description: Implements a barrier synchronization across distributed agents with optional rank tracing.
